create_text_feature: create a Text feature for encoding strings to integers with a TextEncoder
build_text_feature_plain: build a plain Text feature without encoder for storing raw UTF-8 strings
encode_text_example: encode a text example by converting strings to integer lists using the encoder
decode_text_example: decode an integer list back to a string using the TextEncoder decoder
build_text_encoder_corpus: build a SubwordTextEncoder from a corpus generator to construct vocabulary
